title Custom Font Demo (Abaddon Bold)
author polyomino
homepage https://github.com/david-pfx/PuzzleScriptNext

// This demo shows how to use the custom_font prelude directive to replace the
// default Monospace title/menu/message text with a real pixel font, embedded
// permanently as a base64 data: URI so the game never depends on an external
// font host staying online. See Documentation/custom_fonts.html for the
// step-by-step tutorial this demo accompanies.
//
// Font: Abaddon Bold by Nathan Scott (https://caffinate.itch.io/abaddon).
// Note: the download's readme.txt says CC BY 3.0, but the font file's own
// embedded metadata says CC BY-ND 3.0 (no derivatives). This demo embeds the
// exact, unmodified font file, which is fine under either licence -- but if
// you modify a font before embedding it (subsetting, re-hinting, etc.),
// check which licence actually applies.
custom_font data:font/ttf;base64,
font_size 1

text_controls Arrows to move, Z to undo, R to restart

========
OBJECTS
========

Background
LIGHTGRAY GRAY
00010
11111
01000
11111
00010

Wall copy:Background
DARKGRAY BLACK

Target; #0f0
Player; #00f8
Crate; orange

=======
LEGEND
=======

. = Background
# = Wall
P = Player
* = Crate
@ = Crate and Target
O = Target

================
COLLISIONLAYERS
================

Background
Target
Player, Wall, Crate

======
RULES
======

[ > Player | Crate ] -> [ > Player | > Crate ]

==============
WINCONDITIONS
==============

all Target on Crate

=======
LEVELS
=======

message This whole message, the title screen, and the menu above are all rendered in Abaddon Bold -- a real font file, embedded permanently in this game's source as a single custom_font line.
